prompt: Who enters the names of people who attend live?
promptZh: 誰負責登記現場參加人員的姓名？

options.whyZh: 主管可調整工作，但不負責登記現場訓練。
公告說不要請兩位主管登記，由講師負責現場場次。
首段明確說現場場次由講師登記。

options.text: The person covering the loading counter
options.whyZh: 這是受工作限制的人，不是登記者。

explanationZh: 首段明確說現場場次由講師登記。
evidence: The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count.

vocabulary.note: 在當場參加，而非事後觀看錄影。
